question: If the royal candidates were cheated on by their boyfriends, how would they respond?
answer: Priscilla: “He’ll be coming back anyways. I’m not going to get worked up over a little thing like that. I’ll kill him if he actually leaves, though.” Anastasia: “Cutting off ties is cutting off money. I paid you well to learn that lesson. How I go about getting it back is up to me, you know?” Crusch: “I bear some responsibility for not being a good companion. I’ve given up any hope of finding happiness as a woman, after all.” (Killed by Ferris at a later date) Felt: “I’m not really worried about it, but it’s not about whether you like a person like that or not. It’s about whether you forgive them or not.” Emilia: “Ah, I see. ...Mhmm, it’s fine. I wasn’t taking care of things like I should have, either. I think that, so… mhmm, I’m sorry.”
